subject: Nimbus Health — EU analytics enclave add + renewal term tradeoffs
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@nimbushealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:14:00Z
Subject: Renewal planning — EU analytics enclave + isolation

Hi Hannah,

As we approach our renewal window (Oct 1), the leadership team wants to discuss expanding our Private footprint in the EU. Specifically: an isolated analytics enclave (separate cluster) to keep analytics workloads in a strictly controlled EU-only VPC, with a dedicated KV cache and storage partitioning for residency. Current ask is: +2 clusters (m5-like GPUs) in eu-west + data residency controls + a staged provisioning plan to minimize cutover risk.

We'd also like to explore an 18‑month committed term as part of the renewal instead of the standard 12 to smooth budget approvals, but we care about phased billing tied to provisioning milestones. Can we set up a call next week to review options and an estimated uplift?

Thanks,
Lina
CTO, Nimbus Health

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU analytics enclave + isolation

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask. Marcus (solutions) and our commercial lead Kim will join to scope capacity and the pricing tradeoffs.

Proposed next steps:
- 30m call to align on topology and residency controls (I can do Wed 8/20 10:00 CEST or Thu 8/21 15:00 CEST)
- Marcus to draft a quick spec + estimated uplift for +2 clusters and isolation controls
- We’ll prepare a commercial term summary showing 12 vs 18 month economics and phased billing options

Confirm which time works and I’ll send calendar invite.

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU analytics enclave + isolation

Hi team,

Thanks for the call earlier. Per discussion, high-level technical proposal attached (Nimbus_EU_cluster_spec.pdf). Highlights: 
- Topology: 2 additional dedicated GPU clusters (in eu-west), each with its own control-plane namespace and KV cache.
- Isolation: VPC peering with strict ACLs; automated network policies for cross-env traffic; separate S3-equivalent buckets with EU-only keys.
- Provisioning cadence: Phase 1 (cluster A, infra + storage) in 6–8 weeks; Phase 2 (cluster B, replication + analytics pipelines) in additional 4–6 weeks.
- Fallback plan: routing policy that fails over to hosted fallback within same region for read-only workloads in case of cutover issues.

Estimated commercial uplift: ~+38% on current committed spend for the added clusters and isolation controls (ballpark). I’ve included a provisional provisioning_timeline_v1.odt in case procurement needs milestones.

Let me know if we should tighten the security controls (e.g., HSM-backed KMS) — that can add ~5–8% and 2–3 weeks to provisioning.

Regards,
Marcus
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_EU_cluster_spec.pdf, provisioning_timeline_v1.odt
From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-24T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU analytics enclave + isolation

> 
> Thanks for the call earlier. Per discussion, high-level technical proposal attached...

Thanks — that proposal is helpful. Two quick commercial asks from procurement: 
1) Can Redwood offer milestone-based invoicing (Phase 1 / Phase 2)?
2) If we commit to an 18-month term and take both clusters at go-live, what is the best price you can provide (we’re looking for a committed discount vs the estimated +38%)?

Also Lina asked about audit evidence for data residency controls (SOC2 evidence + network diagrams) we can share with our compliance team.

Oliver
Director of IT Ops — Nimbus Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-27T08:21:00Z

Thanks,

Date: 2026-09-08T16:02:00Z

Hi Lina / Oliver — following up with the proposed commercial path. Summary:
- Offer: Add 2 dedicated EU clusters + isolation package.
- Term: 18 months (starts at go‑live signoff for Phase 1).
- Pricing: We can do a 22% uplift vs current committed baseline (i.e., approximately a 16% discount vs the earlier +38% ballpark).
- Billing: Milestone invoicing (Phase 1 50% on infra ready + 25% on cluster B go-live + remainder on full acceptance).
- Acceptance: signoff by Nimbus application owners; 10 business day remediation window for critical issues.

Next steps: if this aligns, I’ll send an amendment and DocuSign link for internal approvals. Also linking the compliance share and a short term-summary (commercial_term_summary.xlsx).

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/NIM-2026-07/term-sheet
Redwood deal page: https://app.redwood.com/deals/NIM-2026-07

Thanks all — we’ll target a Sep 15 commercial signoff to meet provisioning timelines.

Best,
Kim Park
Commercial Lead — Redwood Inference
